item.title: James Madison U. wants students to learn how to deliberate respectfully
item.description: James Madison University is enhancing its civic education initiatives with a $2.72 million federal grant aimed at promoting reasoned debate and diverse perspectives. The funding is part of a broader Trump administration effort to support civil discourse on college campuses.

item.title: Baylor doc sues after rape allegation, DOJ charges for exposing trans procedures
item.description: Biden's DOJ and his colleagues targeted him. Now he's fighting back with a lawsuit.

item.title: Former UCSB student government president sues school alleging antisemitic harassment
item.description: The lawsuit alleges student was 'victim of repeated and systematic assaults and other abuse by a horde of antisemitic instigators on campus.'

item.title: Penn president who flopped on ‘genocide’ question to lead Georgetown Law
item.description: Liz Magill, former president of the University of Pennsylvania who faced backlash for her comments on antisemitism, will become the new dean of Georgetown Law.

item.title: U. Illinois grad fellowships require ‘commitment to diversity and inclusion’
item.description: A scholar critiques DEI requirements for graduate school fellowships at the University of Illinois, asserting that public universities should use taxpayer funds neutrally.

item.title: Yale’s new antisemitism scholar despises Christians
item.description: Yale antisemitism scholar swaps one form of hatred for another.

item.title: What can you actually say? Understanding the boundaries of free expression on campus
item.description: The College Fix's Hannah Brady talks to the Foundation for Individual Rights and Education's Marie McMullen about the state of campus free speech, the biggest threats to free speech, how those threats have changed over time, and what the limits -- if any -- to free speech should be.

item.title: DEI remains strong at UMich a year after president promised to gut it
item.description: University of Michigan promised to get rid of DEI. It's still alive and kicking.
